Hi Liam — thanks for the quick reply and for the details.

Short answers up front: we do not require COI to create the vendor master; COI is typically requested at contract stage for services above our risk threshold. For master-data and PO routing we need the documents below. Once received, procurement will create the vendor record and route a test PO to confirm remit details.

Required items for vendor master setup (please provide one of each where applicable):
- Completed vendor intake spreadsheet (I can send a portal link or accept the attached xlsx).
- W-9 (or local tax equivalent for non-US entities).
- AP contact name, email, and ACH routing instructions (bank account details should be sent via our secure vendor portal or DocuSign).
- Legal entity name as it appears on tax docs and the state/country of incorporation.

Our next steps / timelines:
1) You upload the vendor intake spreadsheet and W-9 to the secure portal: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboard (preferred), or return them to accounts@redwood.com if portal is not available.
2) Procurement (me) verifies fields and creates the master record — target SLA 3 business days after complete docs received.
3) AP (Marissa) will issue a test PO and confirm ACH data with your AP contact.

A couple of clarifying questions for your team:
- Is TurningPoint set up to receive a small-dollar test PO for payment routing validation?
- Are any invoices sent by individual contributors (i.e., do you have multiple remit emails we should register?)

If you prefer, I can create a ticket on our side and send a one-click secure upload link (DocuSign/portal) to Jenna so she can drop the bank details safely.

Best,
